title_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Orientim Perfekt!!
description_sq: Tek Univers City, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Me Orientim Perfekt!!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 3, si dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 119.75 m2, nga ku siperfaqja neto eshte 98.07 m2. Organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet prona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete.
title_en: In Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, with perfect orientation!!
description_en: At Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1+2, With Perfect Orientation!!! The property is located on the 3rd floor, and has a gross area of ​​119.75 m2, of which the net area is 98.07 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The orientation of the property is South-West, the apartment has a view of the park and is currently in the final stage. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
